events.title: Stargazing at Las Positas College
events.description:
Star party at Las Positas College. Set up at 8:00 in Lot J overlooking the field. There are a few lights in the parking lot to contend with, but it is fairly dark toward the east. Please send me an email or reply to this message if you are planning on bringing a telescope.
 
Thanks,
Johnathan Bailey

events.title: TVS Club Meeting
H2O open house
events.description:
Description


A trip for club members and the public to TVS’s dark observing site. Meet at the corner of Mines and Tesla Roads. The caravan to the site leaves at 6:00 pm sharp. Bring $3 for site admission.  This is also an opportunity for members who want access but have not completed site orientation to do so.
events.location: Meet at the corner of Mines and Tesla Roads

events.title: Public Star Party at Delle Valle Arroyo Staging Area
events.description: Public star party at Del Valle Arroyo Staging Area.  Del Valle Arroyo Rd Staging area for Saturday August 30. Sunset is about 7:40. Setup at 7:15 The public portion will go from about sunset to 10 pm when the park closes. TVS members are welcome to stay after the public leaves.

events.title: TVS Club Meeting
events.description: TVS Club meetings are open to all members and the public. See TVS newsletter www.trivalleystargazers.org for details on how to participate in the zoom video conference call.

events.title: Public Star Party at Sunol Regional Wilderness
events.description:
Public star party at Sunol Regional Wilderness. Set up 6:45.  Observing starts 7:30 pm, ends about 9:30 or 10 pm. Map to the parking lot we will be setting up in https://maps.app.goo.gl/sGxWWiah37SY7rhN8. Moon is a few days past new, and Saturn will be rising early in the evening. Please let me know if you are planning on bringing a telescope or binoculars to share with the public.
 
Thanks,
Johnathan Bailey

events.title: Stargazing at the Livermore Library
events.description: Stargazing at the Livermore library. They said we can start setting up after 5, though that is pretty early. Let's start set up at 6. Presentation starts at 6:30 pm. I will take any volunteer for that, or I will do the presentation myself. Telescope stuff starts about 7 pm.
events.location: Livermore Library 1188 S Livermore Ave, Livermore, CA 94550

events.title: School Star Party at Murray Elementary School
events.description:
School star party at Murray Elementary. They had a good blacktop that we could drive out to last time. Set up 6:30 observing once Saturn is visible until about 9:30. Please let me know if you can make it.
 
Thanks,
Johnathan
events.location: Murray Elementary School, 8435 Davona Dr, Dublin, CA 94568
